source: Venue facts read live on 2026-10-05 (see vienna-clubs-editorial-review.md claim ledger): Wikipedia and Falter, Resident Advisor, Groove, heute.at and edison for Pratersauna; grelleforelle.com for Grelle Forelle; flex.at, Austria-Forum and Wikipedia for Flex; vienna.at and Google Arts & Culture for Fluc; meinbezirk, Vice and wien.info for Das Werk; Wikipedia, vormagazin.at and 1000thingsmagazine for the Volksgarten and Das Techno Cafe. Capacities, Das Werk's single founding year and Pratersauna after September 2026 are unresolved and left out of the copy.
